texte:
TUNIS, THE ROOFTOP IS CALLING! 🧡

November is flying by, but there’s still plenty of life upstairs!

This week we’re mixing things up: radio sessions, jazz, eclectic sounds, deep house and indie grooves. A different flavour every night, a different reason to drop by.

And with JAOU entering its final week, the festival spirit is still very much in the air. We’re keeping the good times rolling at Habibi, all the way to the closing celebrations. ✨

Bring your friends, find your spot, grab a bite and enjoy the view. The rest will take care of itself. ❤️

🌇 Open from 4PM
🎶 Music from 8PM to 00:30AM
🍴 Food · 🍸 Drinks · 🌃 Rooftop views
✨ Free entry

texte:
SEVEN NIGHTS, SEVEN DIFFERENT MOODS. ❤️‍🔥

Radio on, volume up, and the rooftop is calling!

From our radio sessions to live performances, a special Warehouse night and Fréquences Croisées, featuring the return of a son of the city, Tarouq, performing live we’ve got a full week of sounds and surprises lined up.

And of course, JAOU Nights keep the celebration going all the way through the weekend. 🪩

Different sounds, familiar faces, good food, cold drinks and the Habibi rooftop feeling.

📅 9–15 November
🌇 Open from 4PM
🎶 Music from 8PM to 00:30AM
🍴 Food · 🍸 Drinks · 🌃 Rooftop views

Seven nights. One rooftop. All yours.

See you upstairs! ❤️
